text:
sam: Hey team — POC with HelixPay in 30m. Every /v1/generate returns 403: {"error":{"message":"permission denied: org binding","code":403}}. They say they copied the key from the console. Need a quick triage. :rotating_light:

lina: that message usually means the key is bound to a different org than the one in the request (or SDK env). Ask for sanitized headers and key id/account id.

sam: pasted sanitized request: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_hp_demo_77" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"ping"}'
```
No Redwood-Org or X-Project header included. Dashboard says key bound to org `helix-internal`. Customer says their app sets REDWOOD_ORG=helix-production.

mike: env var mismatch is the common culprit. If their app env says helix-production but key bound to helix-internal you'll get that 403. Quick fixes: 1) ask them to set header `Redwood-Org: helix-internal`, 2) create a new key scoped to helix-production, 3) temporary server-side alias mapping for requests with no org header. For a demo, #1 or #3 are fastest.

presales-bot: Note: trial keys created via sales console default to being org-scoped. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#key-bindings :information_source:

lina: can we do a mapping instead of forcing their security team to rotate keys? They said rotation requires change freeze.

mike: yes — we can add a temporary alias so requests with REDWOOD_ORG=helix-production map to helix-internal for this account for up to 60 minutes. Needs SecOps approval and an audit entry.

security: SecOps can approve a 60-minute mapping for acct_ac_9021 and key id key_hp_77 with audit. Please provide justification and confirm scope (org mapping only, no permission changes).

sam: acct: acct_ac_9021, key id: key_hp_77. Justification: live sales demo, customer cannot rotate keys due to change freeze. Require only org alias from helix-production -> helix-internal and a short RPS bump to 25 because they reported some 429s earlier.

security: approved. Audit entry created: "TEMP-ORG-ALIAS acct_ac_9021 key_hp_77 map helix-production->helix-internal expire=60m approver=SecOps reason=live demo". RPS bump to 25 approved for same window.

mike: mapping and rate bump scheduled in 2 minutes. Lina, tell the customer to retry this debug curl after 2m: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_hp_demo_77" 
 -H "Redwood-Org: helix-production" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"status"}'
```
If they still get 403 capture `x-rw-request-id` and DM infra.

sam: customer just ran it and reports 200! They say demo can proceed. Thanks all :tada:

customer-rep: Thanks team — appreciate the quick exception and audit trail. We'll follow up post-demo about rotating to a properly scoped key.

lina: great — follow-up action: create a ticket to remind customer to rotate key within 24h and close audit once rotated. :white_check_mark:
